name: Assistance to Co-operative Irrigation Societies (Trible Area)
benefit: - **Monetary Support:** Financial help is provided for the installation of electric motors and pumps on wells and agar creeks to enhance irrigation facilities.
_eligibility_text: - Cooperative irrigation societies formed by small and marginal farmers, or any other farmers, are eligible under this scheme. - The society should be located within the state of Gujarat. - The Scheme is applicable to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
